title: Wellbeing Frameworks
learningGoal: Teach parents how to support children’s wellbeing across emotional, physical, social, and cognitive domains.
microLesson: Wellbeing includes safety, connection, learning, health, and emotional regulation. Parents support wellbeing by creating routines, offering warmth, encouraging learning, and modelling healthy coping.
activity: Identify one wellbeing area to strengthen this week. Reflect on the action you took.
